name: evo_compact
description: Garbage-collect and merge multiple fragmented, stale, or low-hit capabilities into a single high-density entry, archiving the old versions to .evo/archive/ to free up the 1,500-token core budget.

merged_proposal.description: The consolidated ProposalPayload (same schema as evo_propose) that replaces target_ids.

target_ids.description: Array of existing capability IDs (minimum 2) to archive and merge.

workspace.description: Optional absolute path to the active project workspace. Routes EvoKernel to the nearest .evo/ directory at or above this path instead of the MCP server process cwd.
